results.title: Kaduna–Kano Railway Reaches 90% Completion, Outstanding Land Issues Delay Final Connection
results.snippet:
Nigeria’s Kaduna–Zaria–Kano standard gauge railway project has reached approximately 90% completion, according to the Permanent Secretary of the Federal Ministry of Transportation, Engr. Funso Adebiyi.

results.snippet:
